## Framing

The typically developing reference for words understood. The structure follows [VG02](vg02.qmd), with the TD-specific configuration matching [VG03](vg03.qmd). See the [methods chapter](methods.qmd) for the shared specification.

## Model specification

VG04 instantiates the shared model backbone with:

- `n_trials = 690`
- slope anchors $(12, 26)$ months
- 10 % Wordbank sample (`random_seed = 47`)
- 1 655 observations after subsampling

### Slope-anchor priors

At 12 months a small but nonzero understood vocabulary is typical:

$$p_{12} \sim \mathrm{Beta}(1, 20), \qquad p_{26} \sim \mathrm{Beta}(1.5, 1.1).$$

The $p_{12}$ prior places more mass at low proportions than the corresponding VG02 DS prior (`Beta(1, 10)`), reflecting that 12 months is roughly the *start* of the TD comprehension acceleration whereas 24 months — VG02's lower anchor — is well into the DS comprehension trajectory.

The remaining priors follow the family-wide values in the [methods chapter](methods.qmd).

## Results

### Diagnostics

VG04 sampled at rep quality: r̂_max = 1.000, ESS_bulk_min = 9 553 across reported parameters, zero divergences, 25 m 04 s wall time. elpd_loo = −9 925.6 (n = 1 655 observations).

### Population trajectory

Indicative typical values:

| Age (months) | Understood (median) |
| ---: | :--- |
| 9 | 49 [41–57] |
| 12 | 83 [76–90] |
| 18 | 134 [126–143] |
| 24 | 276 [263–290] |
| 30 | 430 [404–456] |

The understood trajectory in TD rises faster than the spoken trajectory at every age, but the gap closes rapidly: by ~24 months TD children are saying close to every word they understand. The joint model [VG06](vg06.qmd) makes this explicit and provides the matched-comprehension TD reference used throughout the [model comparison chapter](model-comparison.qmd).

The full posterior summary table and figures are in `output/models/VG04-age-understood-td/`. The rendered per-model report is `output/models/VG04-age-understood-td/index.html`.

## Status of VG04 in the family

VG04 is the TD reference for words understood in the matched-age comparison `output/comparisons/ds_td_understood_by_age.{png,svg}`. The joint TD reference used for matched-comprehension comparisons is [VG06](vg06.qmd).

## Limitations

Identical to [VG03](vg03.qmd): the subsampling trade-off, the instrument and population mix in Wordbank, and the age-range mismatch with the DS data.
